skills.description: Design additions and changes to modules, interface contracts and shared state.
skills.instructions: Define responsibilities, contracts and recovery for the current design. For complex transitions, event interleavings or critical consistency risks, use [section 3.2.1](references/standard/3-workflow/3.2-requirements-and-design.md#321-plan-state-modeling-and-review) and the [bundled state-modeling method](references/methods/statechart/METHOD.md) to verify existing tools and run applicable checks. Do not delegate automatically.
skills.name: devnorm-design

skills.description: Reproduce defects and verify root causes and repairs.
skills.instructions: Reproduce before diagnosing; replay the original failure without treating substitute or environment results as success.
skills.name: devnorm-debug

skills.description: Independently review a fixed candidate against standards and specifications.
skills.instructions: One non-author primary reviewer starts in a fresh session, then continues incremental reviews and replays original failures. Fix the semantic unit or final combination, base, exact inputs, and cumulative budget. Personally run critical paths. Replace the reviewer after implementation edits; this entry grants no editing or merge authority.
skills.name: devnorm-review

skills.description: Verify actual CLI, service, browser, and native behavior.
skills.instructions: Reuse existing controls for normal acceptance. Create or maintain verification tooling only when explicitly requested; missing tools are not a pass.
skills.name: devnorm-verify

skills.instructions: Use the decision-interview mode. Bound topic and rounds/time, then stop at implementable scope.
skills.name: devnorm-interview

skills.description: Recover historical context for a specified project and scope.
skills.instructions: Bound project, topic, and time. Prefer existing continuation records without searching other projects or editing memory stores.
skills.name: devnorm-recall

skills.description: Apply test-first cycles to defined logic and cheaply reproducible defects.
skills.instructions: Choose the appropriate test boundary, run valid red-green-refactor cycles, preserve existing assertions, and retain real acceptance.
skills.name: devnorm-tdd

skills.description: Manually check sources and analyze new capabilities.
skills.instructions: Run maintenance commands only in an actual DevNorm source checkout. Separate scanning, agent analysis, adoption, programmatic packaging, and installation. Do not maintain source in a target project or installed cache.
skills.name: devnorm-sources
